name: com.bottrunk/bottrunk
title: BotTrunk
description: Pay-per-call AI services for agents: USDC over x402 on Algorand, paid from your own wallet.

environmentVariables.name: BOTTRUNK_MNEMONIC
environmentVariables.description: 25-word Algorand mnemonic of the paying wallet. Omit to use ~/.bottrunk/wallet.json (run `npx bottrunk-mcp wallet`).

environmentVariables.name: BOTTRUNK_MAX_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single call above this many USDC (decimal, e.g. 0.05). "none" disables.

environmentVariables.name: BOTTRUNK_MAX_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Refuse once today's UTC total would exceed this many USDC. "none" disables.

environmentVariables.name: BOTTRUNK_WALLET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of the generated wallet file.
